# IOGAI

> Refrigeration and HVAC repair for homes and businesses across Huntington Beach, Orange
> County, and LA. 10+ years of experience, 5.0 average rating on Google (118 reviews).

## About
IOGAI is a refrigeration and HVAC repair company founded by Igor Ogai, serving Orange County
and LA. IOGAI repairs residential and commercial refrigerators, freezers, walk-in coolers, ice
makers, restaurant equipment, marine refrigeration & AC systems, mortuary refrigeration, and
HVAC systems.

- Website: https://iogai.com
- Address: 517 Frankfort Ave, Huntington Beach, CA 92648
- Hours: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, seven days a week

## Service area
Huntington Beach, Orange County, and Los Angeles.

## Services
- Refrigerator & Freezer Repair - residential and commercial units.
- Commercial Refrigeration & Restaurant Equipment - walk-in coolers, ice makers, restaurant equipment.
- HVAC Repair - heating and air conditioning for homes and small businesses.
- Specialty Refrigeration - marine refrigeration & AC, and mortuary refrigeration.

## Why customers choose us
- 10+ years repairing systems of any complexity.
- 5.0/5 average rating across 118 Google reviews.
- Certified technicians, swift response, service warranty on repairs.
- Emergency repair service available.

## Booking
